title: Talagrand’s discrete-convexity conjecture
summary: We prove Talagrand's discrete-convexity conjecture. There is a universal integer k such that, whenever an arbitrary family has Bernoulli product measure at least $`1-1/k`$, the sets not contained in a union of k members admit a cover of total cost at most 1/2 at the same density.
family_title: Talagrand’s expectation thresholds, discrete convexity, and graph decompositions

review.reason: Proves a discrete-convexity conjecture about covers of set families under product measure.
